name: Microcks Open Source API Mocking and Contract Testing
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source API mocking and contract testing platform for self-managed deployments; imports OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, gRPC, GraphQL and Postman assets, with no vendor-imposed software quota or expiration.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker/Kubernetes infrastructure, storage and operational maintenance; compute, networking and CI runners are not included. Configure authentication and secure mock endpoints before exposing them. This is not a free managed cloud API mocking allowance.
